slides.label: Founder story · Nykaa
slides.big_label: Her age when she started Nykaa in 2012
slides.deck: Falguni Nayar left investment banking to sell beauty online. In *2021* Nykaa went public.

slides.credit: Photo: Ask27 / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0
slides.label: Before Nykaa
slides.deck: She ran Kotak Mahindra's investment bank as managing director and took companies like *DLF*, *Tech Mahindra* and *IDFC* public.

slides.credit: Photo: Jennie Robinson Faber / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0
slides.label: The start, 2012
slides.deck: People told her to sell electronics or fashion online. India had few department stores, so Nykaa served the whole country from *one or two warehouses*.

slides.credit: Photo: Ganesh Dhamodkar / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0
slides.deck: Shares opened at *₹2,018* on the NSE against a ₹1,125 issue price. The IPO was subscribed more than *82 times*.

slides.credit: Photo: Cididity Hat / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0
slides.label: Falguni Nayar to Fortune, Feb 2022
slides.deck: “When we started, I knew some aspects of the business, but I didn’t know beauty, I didn’t know retail. And I gave myself a chance.”
